reference.title: Prerequisites and limitations for auto-pruning and multiple policies
reference.shortdesc: Review these prerequisites and limitations before you configure Red Hat Quay auto-pruning policies for organizations or repositories.

section.p: The following prerequisites and limitations apply to the auto-pruning feature:

ul.li: Auto-pruning is not available when using the Red Hat Quay legacy UI. You must use the v2 UI to create, view, or modify auto-pruning policies.
Auto-pruning is only supported in databases that support the FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED SQL command.
Auto-pruning is unavailable on mirrored repositories and read-only repositories.
Immutable tags are excluded from auto-prune policies and cannot be opted back in. They can still be removed by per-tag expiration, including the quay.expires-after label or annotation.

If you are configuring multiple auto-prune policies, rules are processed without particular order, and individual result sets are processed immediately before moving on to the next rule.
For example, if an image is already subject to garbage collection by one rule, it cannot be excluded from pruning by another rule.
If you have both an auto-pruning policy for an organization and a repository, the auto-pruning policies set at the organization level are executed first.
